## ODOO QUOTE CALCULATOR APP - COMPREHENSIVE CODEBASE OVERVIEW

### 1. PROJECT STRUCTURE & TYPE

**Project Type:** Odoo Enterprise Pricing Quote Calculator Web Application
- **Architecture:** Full-stack TypeScript/React application with Express.js backend
- **Frontend Framework:** React 18 with TailwindCSS
- **Backend:** Express.js 5.0 with Node.js
- **Database:** PostgreSQL with Drizzle ORM
- **Build Tool:** Vite (with development HMR support)
- **UI Component Library:** Radix UI + shadcn/ui

---

### 2. FRONTEND FILES (CLIENT STRUCTURE)

**Main Entry Points:**
- `/home/runner/workspace/client/index.html` - HTML entry point
- `/home/runner/workspace/client/src/main.tsx` - React app entry point
- `/home/runner/workspace/client/src/App.tsx` - Main app component with routing

**Key Pages/Components:**
- `/home/runner/workspace/client/src/pages/Calculator.tsx` - Main quote calculator page (1188 lines - comprehensive pricing engine)
- `/home/runner/workspace/client/src/pages/not-found.tsx` - 404 page

**Custom Components:**
- `/home/runner/workspace/client/src/components/ui-custom.tsx` - Custom components: GlassCard, InputField, Button, Switch, Select

**UI Component Library (48 files):**
- `/home/runner/workspace/client/src/components/ui/` - Contains all Radix UI wrapped components:
  - accordion, alert, alert-dialog, aspect-ratio, avatar, badge, breadcrumb, button, calendar, card, carousel, chart, checkbox, collapsible, command, context-menu, dialog, drawer, dropdown-menu, form, hover-card, input, input-otp, label, menubar, navigation-menu, pagination, popover, progress, radio-group, resizable, scroll-area, select, separator, sheet, sidebar, skeleton, slider, switch, table, tabs, textarea, toast, toaster, toggle, toggle-group, tooltip

**Hooks:**
- `/home/runner/workspace/client/src/hooks/use-quotes.ts` - React Query hooks for quote API (useQuotes, useQuote, useCreateQuote)
- `/home/runner/workspace/client/src/hooks/use-toast.ts` - Custom toast notification system
- `/home/runner/workspace/client/src/hooks/use-mobile.tsx` - Mobile breakpoint detection (768px)

**Styling & Utilities:**
- `/home/runner/workspace/client/src/index.css` - Global styles with Tailwind, Odoo theme colors, custom utilities
- `/home/runner/workspace/client/src/lib/utils.ts` - Utility: cn() function (classname merging with clsx + tailwind-merge)
- `/home/runner/workspace/client/src/lib/queryClient.ts` - React Query configuration with custom apiRequest function

**Assets:**
- `/home/runner/workspace/client/public/favicon.png` - Favicon
- `/home/runner/workspace/client/public/` - Static assets directory

---

### 3. STYLING & THEME FILES

**CSS:**
- `/home/runner/workspace/client/src/index.css` - Global stylesheet with:
  - Odoo brand colors: Primary (#714B67), Secondary (#017E84)
  - CSS variables for light theme
  - Custom utilities: glass-panel, glass-card, text-gradient, input-premium, odoo-primary-bg, odoo-secondary-bg
  - Custom scrollbar styling
  - Print media styles

**Tailwind Configuration:**
- `/home/runner/workspace/tailwind.config.ts` - Extended Tailwind with:
  - Custom border radius (lg: 9px, md: 6px, sm: 3px)
  - HSL-based color system (background, foreground, card, primary, secondary, accent, destructive, ring, chart, sidebar)
  - Font family variables
  - Accordion animation keyframes
  - Plugins: tailwindcss-animate, @tailwindcss/typography

**PostCSS:**
- `/home/runner/workspace/postcss.config.js` - PostCSS configuration

---

### 4. BACKEND FILES (SERVER STRUCTURE)

**Server Entry:**
- `/home/runner/workspace/server/index.ts` - Express app setup, middleware, logging, error handling

**API Routes:**
- `/home/runner/workspace/server/routes.ts` - Quote API endpoints:
  - `POST /api/quotes` - Create quote
  - `GET /api/quotes/:id` - Get quote by ID
  - `GET /api/quotes` - List quotes (defined in shared routes but not implemented)

**Database:**
- `/home/runner/workspace/server/db.ts` - Drizzle ORM connection to PostgreSQL
- `/home/runner/workspace/server/storage.ts` - DatabaseStorage class implementing:
  - User operations (getUser, getUserByUsername, createUser)
  - Quote operations (createQuote, getQuote)

**Vite Integration:**
- `/home/runner/workspace/server/vite.ts` - Development server setup with HMR
- `/home/runner/workspace/server/static.ts` - Production static file serving

---

### 5. SHARED/SCHEMA FILES

**Database Schema:**
- `/home/runner/workspace/shared/schema.ts` - Drizzle schema definitions:
  - `users` table (id, username, password)
  - `quotes` table (id, users, plan, implementation, termDiscounts, selectedTerms)
  - Zod validation schemas

**API Routes Definition:**
- `/home/runner/workspace/shared/routes.ts` - Type-safe API route definitions:
  - `/api/quotes` (GET - list, POST - create)
  - `/api/quotes/:id` (GET - get single)
  - Error schemas for validation/notFound/internal errors

---

### 6. PDF GENERATION

**Location & Implementation:**
- **File:** `/home/runner/workspace/client/src/pages/Calculator.tsx` (lines 371-637)
- **Library:** jsPDF (imported at line 13)
- **Function:** `handleExportPDF()` (lines 372-637)
- **Trigger:** "Export" button in header (line 656)

**PDF Features:**
- **Format:** Portrait A4 with 20px margins
- **Header:** Odoo branding color bar (#714B67), title with date
- **Configuration Display:** User count, plan, currency, implementation
- **Table Layout:** Dynamic column widths based on selected terms
- **Rows Included:**
  - Software License
  - Implementation (conditional)
  - Odoo SH Hosting (conditional)
  - Savings (conditional, green highlight)
  - Total Contract (highlighted row)
  - Monthly Cost Amortized
  - Financing section (Catalyst Finance - 6% to 13% APR, conditional)
  - Partner Payout view (MRR/NRR, internal only, conditional)
- **Styling:** Uses Odoo brand colors, alternating row backgrounds, professional borders
- **Footer:** Disclaimer text and document attribution

---

### 7. BUILD & CONFIG FILES

**Configuration Files:**
- `/home/runner/workspace/package.json` - Dependencies & scripts (dev, build, start, check)
- `/home/runner/workspace/vite.config.ts` - Vite build configuration with React plugin
- `/home/runner/workspace/tsconfig.json` - TypeScript configuration
- `/home/runner/workspace/tailwind.config.ts` - Tailwind styling (see section 3)
- `/home/runner/workspace/postcss.config.js` - PostCSS plugins
- `/home/runner/workspace/drizzle.config.ts` - Drizzle ORM configuration
- `/home/runner/workspace/components.json` - shadcn/ui configuration

---

### 8. KEY TECHNOLOGIES & DEPENDENCIES

**Frontend:**
- react@18.3.1, react-dom@18.3.1
- @tanstack/react-query@5.60.5 (data fetching)
- @radix-ui/* (50+ component packages)
- tailwindcss@3.4.17, @tailwindcss/vite@4.1.18
- framer-motion@11.13.1 (animations)
- lucide-react@0.453.0 (icons)
- react-hook-form@7.55.0, zod@3.24.2 (forms & validation)
- jspdf@4.1.0 (PDF generation)
- wouter@3.3.5 (routing)
- recharts@2.15.2 (charts, not currently used on main page)
- next-themes@0.4.6 (theme support)

**Backend:**
- express@5.0.1
- drizzle-orm@0.39.3, drizzle-kit@0.31.8
- pg@8.16.3
- typescript@5.6.3
- tsx@4.20.5 (TypeScript execution)

---

### 9. CALCULATOR LOGIC & PRICING ENGINE

**Location:** `/home/runner/workspace/client/src/pages/Calculator.tsx`

**Key Features:**
1. **Country Support:** US ($) and Canada ($)
2. **Plan Types:** Standard and Custom
3. **Pricing Models:**
   - Monthly and yearly subscription rates
   - Year 1 vs Year 2+ different rates
   - Implementation hour-based pricing
   - Odoo SH (Self-Hosted) with workers, storage, staging

4. **Calculations:**
   - Software license cost based on users × rate × months
   - Implementation cost with optional multiplier
   - Odoo SH monthly cost (separate for monthly vs annual terms)
   - Total contract value
   - Amortized monthly cost
   - Savings calculation (comparing monthly vs yearly commitment)
   - Financing estimates using Catalyst Finance APR (6%-13%)

5. **Terms:** Monthly, 1-5 year commitments with independent discounts
6. **Discount Model:** Separate Plan % and Implementation % discounts per term
7. **Partner Payout View:** MRR (Monthly Recurring Revenue) and NRR (Non-Recurring Revenue) calculations

---

### 10. STATE MANAGEMENT

**React State** in Calculator.tsx:
- `country` - Selected currency (US/CA)
- `users` - Number of users
- `plan` - Plan type (standard/custom)
- `implementation` - Implementation package
- `implMultiplier` - Implementation cost multiplier
- `shEnabled` - Odoo SH hosting toggle
- `shHostingType` - shared/dedicated hosting
- `shWorkers/Storage/Staging` - SH configuration
- `termDiscounts` - Per-term discounts
- `selectedTerms` - Active terms for comparison
- `showPayoutView` - Partner payout visibility

**Server State:**
- React Query for remote state management
- Mutation for creating quotes
- Queries for fetching quotes

---

### 11. DATABASE SCHEMA

**Users Table:**
```
id (UUID), username (unique), password
```

**Quotes Table:**
```
id (serial), users (int), plan (text), implementation (text),
termDiscounts (jsonb), selectedTerms (jsonb)
```

---

### 12. RESPONSIVE DESIGN

- **Layout:** 2-panel layout (340-380px sidebar + flexible main)
- **Sidebar:** Controls panel with scroll
- **Main Area:** Quote comparison cards with scroll
- **Header:** Sticky navigation bar
- **Mobile Breakpoint:** 768px (use-mobile hook)

---

### 13. ABSOLUTE PATHS TO KEY FILES

| Category | Path |
|----------|------|
| Main App | `/home/runner/workspace/client/src/App.tsx` |
| Calculator | `/home/runner/workspace/client/src/pages/Calculator.tsx` |
| PDF Export | `/home/runner/workspace/client/src/pages/Calculator.tsx` (lines 371-637) |
| Styling | `/home/runner/workspace/client/src/index.css` |

| Storage/DB Access | `/home/runner/workspace/server/storage.ts` |
| Custom Components | `/home/runner/workspace/client/src/components/ui-custom.tsx` |
| Quote Hooks | `/home/runner/workspace/client/src/hooks/use-quotes.ts` |
| Toast Hook | `/home/runner/workspace/client/src/hooks/use-toast.ts` |

---

### 14. ENTRY POINTS SUMMARY

- **Frontend Entry:** `client/src/main.tsx` → `App.tsx` → Routes → `Calculator.tsx` (main page)
- **Backend Entry:** `server/index.ts` → Vite/Static serving + API routes
